positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead, Amazon Fashion, Amazon Retail
Projects: Shoefitr, Bra-fitter, How It Fits
•	Lead transition of the shoefitr team (amazon acquired company) onboarding to Amazon Tech System
•	Design and Re-architecting shoefitr product integration to Amazon.com (e2e system from UI to service layer cross multiple platforms). This feature increased non-replenishment athletic shoes’s order per sale (OPS) by 1.36%.
•	Design/Build mobile/tablet web experience for how-it-fit E2E from UI to service layer. This feature increased purchased units by 2.17% in the US.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Amazon Mobile
º Amazon App Suite for Android
Background: Amazon App Suite is a widget that unifies all Amazon digital and shopping mobile phone applications into a single customer experience. It, along with each individual content application, is pre-loaded onto Android phones by carriers. Verizon is our target launch partner and It was shipped on the HTC DNA/Samsung Note 2.

Responsibilities:
▶ Lead the overall architecture design for the client. 
▶ Smoothly integrated Single Sign On feature with kindle fire's library into project. Proactively drive technical issues on library till resolved.
▶ Implemented application side authentication components.
▶ Implemented content aggregation to show items to the widget.
▶ Implemented common components for general usage.
▶ Helped/Prototyped SSO feature for mobile shopping application.

º Price Check by Amazon for Android 1.0/1.1 Release

Project Background: PriceCheck is comparison shopping application. It allows a user to search products at hand via barcode, photo, voice, or text search. It also provides rich information, including prices, descriptions, and reviews to aid the consumer’s purchasing decision. For release 1.1, when user submits price information for a product in specific location such as BestBuy, PriceCheck offers special deal to user.

My roles are

▶ Lead the overall architecture design for the client based on shared components. 
▶ Designed and implemented common UI/Utility components for entire shopping applications such as mShop, Windowshop and PriceCheck.
▶ Smoothly integrated with many different libraries into project such as barcode scan library, voice recognition library, and so on.
▶ Implemented most of core components including Home, Search structures which are barcode, voice, image and text.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Developed XecureSmart Client for Android/Bada/iPad

XecureSmart is a solution to ensure the secure data communication between web-server and web-client. It is widely adopted by many internet service companies including several domain leaders, such as Korea Telecom(No.1 mobile service provider in Korea), Samsung and Woori Bank. 

Responsibilities:
* Lead the architecture design for the client based on Android. Drive the entire process from the technical investigation till implementation.
* Designed and Implemented common UI/Utility components for certificate management and data encryption/decryption.
* Drive the entire engineering process; improve the team efficiency by introducing Design Review and Code Review.
* Lead the technical investigation of porting/migrating the client to new platforms such as iPad and bada; Implemented the POC based on the new platform.

positions.title: Junior Engineer - Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Developed IFRS/C (International Financial Reporting Standards/Consolidation), which is the next generation of financial reporting system and is now widely adopted by many big companies including Standard Charted First Bank Korea, Eugene investment & securities and so on. 

My responsibilities are
* Drive the entire development process as one of core developers.
* Directly communicate with customer, responding to their requirements, Drive to adjust the design & implementation to provide end-to-end solutions. Delivered features are highly recognized by the customer
* Build necessary infra-system for other developers.
